title: System Settings
subtitle: Configure site-wide behaviour, branding, and feature toggles.

maintenance.title: We'll be right back
maintenance.description: We're performing scheduled maintenance. Please check back soon.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.description: When on, only admins can reach the app; everyone else sees the maintenance screen.

registration_enabled.label: Registration enabled
registration_enabled.description: When off, new account registration is rejected.

max_upload_size_mb.label: Max upload size (MB)

support_enabled.label: Support enabled
support_enabled.description: When off, users cannot open new support tickets.

site_name.label: Site name
site_name.description: Product name shown across the app and emails.

logo_url.label: Logo
logo_url.description: Site logo. Uploaded to storage; the URL is saved here.
